name: HeyMyra – AI Sales Assistant
author: heymyra

sections.description:
HeyMyra adds Myra, a sales assistant for WooCommerce stores (and WordPress sites). Like a sales assistant in a shop, she:

  • advises your visitors based on your real products, prices, sizes and promotions;
  • answers by voice (natural voice) or in writing, in French, English, Dutch and more;
  • shows the product where it is on your site and highlights it, then opens its product page if the customer asks;
  • adds products to your store’s real cart;
  • answers questions about delivery and returns from your own pages, without making anything up, and remembers the answers you give her;
  • offers your customers to write to you when a question is for you.

Nothing to set up: Myra reads your WooCommerce catalog and your pages on her own. She never appears on checkout, order or customer account pages.

Free to start (no credit card), then paid plans based on the number of conversations.

HeyMyra is made in Belgium and Myra speaks French first.

External services

This plugin adds to your site the script of Myra, an online service (SaaS) provided by HeyMyra (heymyra.be), which runs the assistant.

  • What is sent to Myra: when a visitor opens Myra and writes or talks to her, their messages, the page they are on, the content of their cart and your store’s public catalog are sent to Myra’s servers to produce the answer. By voice, the audio goes through Myra’s voice provider (ElevenLabs) and is not recorded. Conversations are not stored on Myra’s servers.
  • When you connect your site: your site address and the account you create (email).
  • Nothing is sent until the visitor opens Myra, apart from loading the script.
  • Terms of service: https://heymyra.be/cgv
  • Privacy policy: https://heymyra.be/confidentialite
  • Subprocessors: https://heymyra.be/sous-traitance
sections.installation:
1. Plugins > Add New: search for “HeyMyra”, install and activate.
  2. Click “Connect my site to Myra”: create your Myra account (or log in).
  3. That’s all: Myra’s button appears at the bottom right of your site.

You can also paste a key manually in Settings > Myra > Advanced settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know how to code?

No. The plugin adds Myra to your site; connecting takes one click.

Does Myra work without WooCommerce?

Yes: on a showcase site she answers from your pages (services, projects, contact). With WooCommerce, she advises on and sells your products.

Where are my numbers?

In your Myra dashboard: conversations, voice minutes, products added to the cart, and your customers’ unanswered questions.

Can Myra make mistakes?

She only relies on your site and says so when she does not know. Like any AI, she can make mistakes: check what she says about your terms (delivery, returns) and complete the answers in your dashboard.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • Plugin renamed HeyMyra – AI Sales Assistant.
  • Translations are now provided by translate.wordpress.org.

1.3.0

  • Script loaded the way WordPress recommends (wp_enqueue_script, asynchronous loading).
  • English source texts with a French translation included.
  • The connection reminder can be dismissed.
  • Compatible with WordPress 7.1 (WordPress 6.5 minimum).

1.2.0

  • New look: powder pink and burgundy.

1.1.1

  • New Myra address: heymyra.be.

1.1.0

  • “Connect my site to Myra” button: no more key to copy.
  • Myra’s settings page opens right after activation.
  • Reminder in the plugin list until Myra is connected.

1.0.0

  • First version: key to paste, Myra absent from checkout and customer account pages.
